comparison.objective: Assemble a drive-chain joint; candidate adjusts and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Aligning chain links and joint components, inserting/retaining the connecting assembly and controlling small loose parts versus hex-key engagement, collar tuning and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Chain joint completely retained and articulated without missing or damaged components versus two repeatable non-bottoming stops. Candidate dynamic thresholds remain partly unspecified.
comparison.reason: Chain-link joining is an assembly and retention task, not dynamic parameter commissioning.
